findings.title: Manifest-driven stale-file pruning lost its path-containment guard
realGuide.test.ts is environment-dependent on a repo-local guide checkout
findings.description: `INSTALLED_GUIDE = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'project-documents', 'ai-project-guide', 'project-guides')` and `makeProject(tmp, INSTALLED_GUIDE)` does `fs.cpSync` on it; any checkout without the guide installed (fresh clone where the submodule/tarball isn't populated, a CI runner without that step) fails the suite with an ENOENT from the harness, not a skip. I verified the directory exists in this working tree, so the test passes here, but I cannot verify CI provisions it. Note the diff just *removed* a test with the identical property (`readManifest(REPO_ROOT, 'claude')` in `manifest.test.ts`); if repo-local guides are not guaranteed in CI, consider skipping this smoke test when the directory is absent, or confirm the pipeline installs the guide before `pnpm test`.

findings.title: Non-string rules.exclude surfaces as a generic Error with no remediation hint
findings.description: `ConfigManager.get()` does not run the key's validator, so a hand-edited TOML with `rules.exclude = 5` reaches `readRulesExclude`, which throws a plain `Error` ("rules.exclude resolved to a number, expected a string"). It propagates out of `installCheckout` as an uncaught (non-exit-1) error and `handleError` prints `Error: ...` with no `cf config` pointer, unlike every other user-facing failure in this command. The message is adequate; consider a `UserError` naming the key and file location for consistency with the command's other config guidance.

findings.title: Bash-script bridge removed cleanly; new in-process flow is pinned by tests
findings.description: Verified: no remaining references anywhere in `packages/` to `guideScript.ts` exports, `propagateToWorktrees`, `pruneStaleFiles`, `sweepGeneratedPrompts`, `readManifest`, `parseManifestLine`, `manifestTempPath`, `ManifestEntry`, `propagateDirs`, or `generatedPromptDirs`. The new flow is consistent end to end: `setupIdeAction` → `installIde` in-process (root and each worktree from the main checkout's `guideDir`, each with its own `rules.exclude` via `new ConfigManager(wtPath)`), `dryRun` sandboxed and removed in `finally`, failing worktrees recorded and the loop continuing, other exceptions propagating — and each of those behaviors is pinned in `setup-ide.test.ts` (including the "bug propagates and stops the loop" case) and `flags.test.ts` (sandbox cleanup on abort, project tree byte-identical after dry run). The #38/#40 "ported as is" quirks are now fixed with the old behavior explicitly documented as superseded, snapshots regenerated consistently, and `parseRulesExclude` centralized in core with the validator and both readers going through it. No `any` introduced; error handling follows the ported InstallAbort / filesystem-error / rethrow split.
